title: API principles
text: functions start domain: age_*() age groups. period_*() time periods. cohort_*() birth cohorts. three domains usually share operation names. example, age_lower(), period_lower(), cohort_lower() extract lower limits labels.

title: API principles
text: Function names use domain prefix plus operation family. important return-type distinction labels levels: *_labels_*() functions create character vectors labels. *_levels_*() functions return factors, purpose create reorder factor levels.

title: API principles
text: main input argument called labels vector age, period, cohort labels. Arguments beginning interpret_ describe existing input labels parsed. describe newly generated output labels rendered. Age labels follow strong demographic convention: one-year labels use lower boundary, multi-year labels exclude upper boundary. Age functions therefore expose interpret_single interpret_multi arguments. Period cohort labels universal convention, period cohort functions let specify input labels parsed. example, period_standard() uses interpret_multi interpret input: Arguments beginning format_ describe new output labels rendered. example, period_labels_ten() uses format_multi decide whether displayed upper limit included excluded: convention intended keep input interpretation separate output formatting.
code: period_standard("2020-2025", interpret_multi = "exclude") #> [1] "2020-2026" period_labels_ten(   lower_first = 2000,   lower_last = 2020,   format_multi = "exclude" ) #> [1] "2000-2009" "2010-2019" "2020-2029"

title: API principles
text: Boundary arguments name boundary represent. breaks boundaries intervals. lower_first lower bound first generated interval. lower_last lower bound last generated interval. lower_open lower bound right-open age group 70+. upper_open upper bound left-open cohort <1990. boolean argument open used question whether include open interval . Boundary names lower_open upper_open used question open interval starts ends.

text: interpret_single "lower" (default), labels single-year periods assumed refer lower limits, "2025" means [2025,2026). convention data providers typically use calendar years. interpret_single "upper", labels single-year periods assumed refer upper limits, "2025" means [2024,2025). convention data providers typically use non-calendar years, 1 July 30 June. interpret_multi "include" (default), labels multi-year periods assumed include upper limits, "2025-2030" means [2025,2030). interpret_multi "exclude", labels multi-year periods assumed exclude upper limits, "2025-2030" means [2025,2031).
